name: Sardius
overview: The Sardius, also known as the ruby, is a precious stone prominently featured in Scripture as a symbol of divine beauty and authority. It is listed as the first stone set in the high priest's breastplate (Exodus 28:17; 39:10), signifying its importance in representing God's covenant with His people. The Sardius also appears in Ezekiel's description of the garden of Eden, highlighting its association with divine creation and perfection (Ezekiel 28:13). Furthermore, it is included among the foundation stones of the New Jerusalem in John's apocalyptic vision, emphasizing the enduring glory and holiness of God's eternal kingdom (Revelation 21:20).
